_source.title: 设置属性状态：孔
_source.remarks.text.0: 设置孔时将会联动设置部分其它属性状态：
_source.remarks.text.1: 1. 层将会强制切换到多层
_source.remarks.text.2: 本接口无法将孔设置为 `null`，如果想要移除孔属性，请使用 {@link IPCB_PrimitivePad.setState_Layer | setState_Layer} 方法切换层为顶层或底层
_source.example.text.0: 1. 生成本次运行专用的坐标，创建一个无孔的贴片焊盘
_source.example.text.1: 2. 异步模式下设置 35mil 圆孔并提交
_source.example.text.2: 3. 从画布重新读取，确认孔已生效且层被联动切到多层（保留现场供观察）

title: Set the property state: hole
remarks.text.0: When setting the hole, some other property states will be set in conjunction:
remarks.text.1: 1. The layer will be forcibly switched to multi-layer
remarks.text.2: This API cannot set the hole to `null`. If you want to remove the hole property, use the {@link IPCB_PrimitivePad.setState_Layer | setState_Layer} method to switch the layer to the top or bottom layer
